results.title: Best laptop-friendly cafes in Taipei - NomadList Taipei Guide
results.content: Top picks for getting work done: Fika Fika Cafe (Songshan) — award-winning roaster, fast wifi, plenty of outlets, no time limits on weekdays. Cafe Libero (Da'an) — quiet back room, popular with writers. Woolloomooloo (Xinyi) — spacious, Australian-style brunch, good for calls in the corner booths.

results.title: Where I actually get work done in Taipei (freelancer's list)
results.content: Fika Fika remains the gold standard: NT$160 gets you a world-class filter coffee and a guilt-free three hours. Cafe Libero has the best quiet-to-comfort ratio. Avoid weekends everywhere. Honorable mention: the 12F food court of Eslite Xinyi for free seating with a view, if you can live without table service.

results.title: Simple Kaffa Flagship — world champion barista's cafe
results.content: Wu Pao-chun building, Xinyi. Founded by world barista champion Berg Wu. Stunning space, exceptional coffee, but laptop policy varies by section and it gets extremely busy — better for a coffee pilgrimage than a work session. Weekday mornings are your best bet for a seat.
